newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta Hotels to hold road show.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta Hotels to hold road show.

text.p: Indonesia's hotel and property developer and operator Jakarta Hotels Development on Monday said the company plans to hold a road show in April to promote its 500 billion rupiah bonds issue.
"We plan to hold a road show overseas to promote our bonds issue," a company official said. He did not say in which countries the road show would be held.

The company notified the Jakarta Stock Exchange in January that it planned to issue 500 billion rupiah bonds in June with a maturity period of five years and interest rates ranging 8.75 to 9.05 percent per year.
